name: Lab Equipment Booking ADR behavior contract
notes: Checks are explicit, reviewed examples of behavior derived from project/README.md; this is not automatic natural-language interpretation.
Each observed value is emitted by running the C++ implementation through the booking_model executable.
Micro:bit hardware input/output remains a separate integration surface.

checks.description: A new booking begins pending.
An administrator approval changes status to approved.
An administrator rejection changes status to rejected.
The administrator approval operation changes the booking status.
The administrator rejection operation changes the booking status.
The student cancellation operation cancels a pending booking.
A requested booking remains pending for review.
A student can view a booking they requested.
Equipment records its requested booking.
Overlapping reservations for the same equipment are rejected.
Starting an approved booking marks its equipment in use.
Finishing a booking releases the equipment.
Ending an in-use booking changes status to finished.
Cancelling an active booking releases its equipment.
Cancelling an active booking changes status to cancelled.
The board displays P for pending.
The board displays A for approved.
The board displays U for in use.
The board displays F for finished.
The board displays C for cancelled.
The board displays R for rejected.
Button A navigates to the previous booking, wrapping from first to last.
Button B navigates to the next booking, wrapping from last to first.
